hero.title: Control your business, optimize your finances, unlock your growth potential.
hero.description: BelloSuite is the modular invoicing and business management software (ERP) designed for SMEs in Tunisia. One solution to manage everything, in one place.

modules.title: A complete and modular solution
modules.description: BelloSuite adapts to your company's growth by adding new modules according to your functional needs.

stock.title: Inventory Management
stock.description: Real-time stock tracking, inventory movements, shortage alerts, multi-warehouse transfers.

commercial.title: Commercial & Sales
commercial.description: Local and export invoicing, purchase orders, quotes, expense reports, payments and statements.

hr.title: Human Resources
hr.description: Employee management, contracts, administrative absences, professional qualification.

payroll.title: Payroll Management
payroll.description: Generation of payslips compliant with Tunisian law, automated tax and CNSS calculation.

accounting.title: Financial Accounting

projects.title: Projects & Kanban

production.title: Production (MRP)

StockMod.admin_only: Only an administrator can change these settings.
StockMod.alerts_desc: Products below alert threshold and reorder suggestions
StockMod.alerts_rule: A product is flagged when its stock is at or below the higher of its minimum stock and reorder point. Suggested quantity: the configured reorder quantity, otherwise enough to reach twice the threshold.
StockMod.allow_negative_desc: When off, an issue or transfer that would make a warehouse stock negative is refused. Sales (invoices, delivery notes, POS) are never blocked.
StockMod.cmup_hint: Used to recompute the weighted average cost
StockMod.confirm_cancel_inventory: The count will be cancelled: no adjustment will be posted.
StockMod.confirm_transfer_cancel: The transfer will be cancelled without any stock movement.
StockMod.confirm_transfer_delete: The transfer will be permanently deleted.
StockMod.confirm_transfer_validate: Issues from the source warehouse and receipts into the destination warehouse will be posted. This cannot be undone.
StockMod.confirm_validate_inventory: {gaps} line(s) show a variance, worth {value}. Adjustment movements will be posted and the count closed.
StockMod.dashboard_desc: Overview: value, alerts and latest movements
StockMod.delete_warehouse_confirm: Warehouse “{name}” will be deleted. A warehouse holding stock or history cannot be deleted: archive it instead.
StockMod.in_use_error: Used by products: cannot be deleted
StockMod.invalid_movement: Valid product, warehouse and quantity required
StockMod.inventory_already_open: A count is already open for this warehouse: finish or cancel it first.
StockMod.inventory_desc: Physical counts per warehouse, variances and adjustments
StockMod.inventory_snapshot_hint: The warehouse book stock is frozen when the count opens. On validation, each variance (counted − book) posts an adjustment movement.
StockMod.movements_desc: History of receipts, issues, adjustments and transfers
StockMod.name: Name
StockMod.need_warehouse: Create a warehouse first to record movements.
StockMod.no_depot_alert: No warehouse alert (set per-warehouse thresholds on the product page)
StockMod.product_not_in_inventory: “{code}” is not part of this count
StockMod.settings_desc: Stock rules, product categories and units of measure
StockMod.transfer_form_desc: Editable draft; validation posts the issue and receipt movements
StockMod.transfer_invalid_lines: Add at least one line with a positive quantity
StockMod.transfer_need_two: At least two active warehouses are needed for a transfer.
StockMod.uncounted_as_zero: Treat the {count} uncounted line(s) as zero (otherwise they are ignored)
StockMod.valuation_desc: Stock value at weighted average cost, per warehouse and in total
StockMod.warehouse_has_history: This warehouse has history (movements, transfers or counts): archive it instead of deleting.
StockMod.warehouse_has_stock: This warehouse holds stock: empty it (transfer) or archive it.
StockMod.warehouses_desc: Warehouses, managers, default warehouse and archiving

Purchases.orders_desc: Orders sent to suppliers: draft, confirmed, partially received, received.
Purchases.invoices_desc: Commercial and tax documents, matched against receipts.
Purchases.receipts_desc: Stock entries from supplier deliveries, with or without an order.
Purchases.returns_desc: Goods sent back to the supplier (stock exit).
Purchases.invoice_rule: A supplier invoice is a commercial and tax document: it never changes stock. Only goods receipts (entries) and supplier returns (exits) move stock.
Purchases.receipt_rule: Validating a receipt creates a stock entry (reason Purchase) in the chosen warehouse and updates the weighted average cost with the actual cost.
Purchases.po_from_alerts_hint: A draft purchase order will be created with the {count} items to order and their suggested quantities.
Purchases.edit_received_hint: This order has already been partly received: received lines cannot be deleted or switched to another item, and their quantity cannot go below the quantity already received (net of returns). You can add new lines.
Purchases.supplier_locked_received: Supplier cannot be changed after a receipt
Purchases.lock_ORDER_RECEIVED: Order fully received: it can no longer be edited. Use a supplier return to correct quantities.
Purchases.lock_INVOICE_VALIDATED: Invoice validated: it can no longer be edited. To correct it, issue a supplier credit note.
Purchases.lock_INVOICE_PAID: Invoice paid: it can no longer be edited. To correct it, issue a supplier credit note.
Purchases.import_invoice_hint: Take a photo or upload a PDF / an image (5 MB max): fields are pre-filled and you review them before saving. The file is not kept.
Purchases.ocr_unsupported: Unsupported format: PDF, JPEG, PNG or WebP.
Purchases.ocr_no_text: No readable text in this document. Try a sharper photo.
Purchases.ocr_failed: Reading the document failed. You can enter it manually.
Purchases.ocr_stage_ocr_load: Loading text recognition (first time: a few seconds)
Purchases.ocr_consistent: Document read: totals are consistent (net + taxes = gross)
Purchases.ocr_check_totals: Document read: check the totals, they do not add up
Purchases.ocr_review_hint: Highlighted fields (confidence < {threshold}%) should be reviewed before saving.
Purchases.import_order: Import a purchase order or quote (photo/PDF)
Purchases.scan_drop_hint: You can also drag and drop the file here.
Purchases.scan_camera_unavailable: Camera unavailable or blocked. Upload a photo or a PDF instead.
Purchases.scan_webcam_hint: Frame the whole document, flat and well lit, then capture.
Purchases.order_free_text_hint: Lines without a product cannot be received into stock: link them to a product before receiving.
Purchases.scan_desc: Photograph or upload a supplier invoice, purchase order or quote: BelloSuite reads it and pre-fills the document.
Purchases.scan_choose_hint: Choose the document to create: the form opens pre-filled and you review it before saving.
Purchases.scan_handoff_failed: Could not pass the document to the form (browser storage unavailable).
